_comment: Policy for scripts/eda/check_structure.js. A mapped design PASSES only when
every leaf cell is a library cell and nothing is left unmapped. Anything
declared here is reported as BLOCKED (exit 2), never as PASS, so a known
gap cannot hide inside a green result.
Counts are per module definition: the full-SoC flow does not flatten (F7),
so a module instantiated more than once contributes its cells once. Every
module in has_soc is currently instantiated once (checked in RUN-0007).

has_soc.reason: F7/TD-006: inferred memories with no macro implementation. Inventoried in RUN-0009 and re-sized in RUN-0012 (asic/synthesis/memory_inventory.json): APB decode LUT 16x9 in has_soc, boot ROM 4096x32 (16 KiB), TCM 8192x32 (32 KiB), SRAM 32768x32 (128 KiB). The older '3 memories' note undercounted.
